data: Same frozen 50 HotpotQA questions and input token IDs; 29 untruncated and 21 truncated.
teacher_precision: FP32 QK products and softmax, averaged over GQA query heads
labels_usage: TEST DIAGNOSTICS ONLY: forbidden for training, calibration, or hyperparameter selection
parity: Every generated token on both instrumented trajectories must equal the frozen base run; assertion per question.
fixed112_timing: Uninstrumented frozen runtime, separately from teacher collection
model_loading: One model per GPU; questions sharded across four GPUs; no model parallelism
